column1: # ontology-registry.tsv — the ONE source of truth for the pipeline's tracker
# WHY. The node/edge vocabulary — issue-status labels, plan-note sentinels, PR
# merge state, the decision baton, the route enum `issue-state.sh resolve`
# emits — was restated by hand across four contract docs and ~three dozen
# scripts, each knowing its own slice. Nothing enumerated the full alphabets
# or the stores that feed them, so a doc could drift from the code it
# described and a new label or sentinel could appear anywhere in the tree
# with nothing to notice. The derived state graph (ADR 0033) needs ONE typed
# vocabulary to build against, not four restatements to reconcile by eye.
# THE FOUR CONTRACT DOCS point here instead of restating a table:
# The checker fails a doc that drops its pointer or grows a table row whose
# first cell is a registry token (the restatement this file replaces).
#   1. AXIS       one of the axes below (an unknown axis is MALFORMED)
#   2. TOKEN      the vocabulary item, verbatim — a label, a sentinel, a
#                 state name, a node/edge type, a store name
#                   label-field     closed | open   (closed = every value must
#                                   be a state:issue-status row; open = any
#                                   per-instance value, e.g. a claim stamp)
#   4. DETAIL     one-line meaning + the store or script that owns it
# A (AXIS, TOKEN) pair appears at most once. `#` comments and blank lines are
# ignored. Every axis listed under REQUIRED AXES in the checker must carry at
# WHAT THE CHECKER SCANS (the two token grammars a vocabulary item is written
# in, and nothing fuzzier — see its header):
#   * a `fnd:` label token: `fnd:<field>[:<value>...]` with concrete slugs
#     (placeholders like `fnd:<field>:*` reduce to the bare field mention).
#     Verdict: the field must be a `label-field` row; a `closed` field's full
#     token must be a `state:issue-status` row; an `open` field accepts any
#     value. Any segment starting with the `personal-prefix` token is exempt.
#   * a plan sentinel: a markdown list checkbox at line start (`- [m] `) or a
# ADDING A VOCABULARY ITEM: add its row here FIRST (the checker goes red on
# an unlisted token anywhere in the tracked tree), then use it. Legacy
# tokens already in the tree at adoption are carried by the shrink-only
# ontology-grandfather-allowlist.tsv, never by a new row here that pretends
# ── node — the typed things the state graph has vertices for ────────────────
